legend: Built = runs end to end in this prototype. Simulated = runs against a simulator or mock. Planned = designed or partly written, not working yet. Never present Simulated or Planned as Built.

features.name: Case engine, case codes and status flow
features.note: One case record for every channel.

features.name: Channel gateway (one entry for every channel)
features.note: POST /api/channel/{name}.

features.name: Five harm picks with severity 1 to 4
features.note: One shared file used by every channel.

features.name: Keyword escalator
features.note: English list working; Luganda, Swahili and Runyankore terms are drafts awaiting native-speaker review.

features.name: AI triage
features.note: Lexicon rules v0.3 plus the rule engine. Recall on severity 3-4 is 0.92 (24 of 26, 95% CI 0.76-0.98) on hard test set 2, against a 0.90 target; the same person wrote that set and the rules, and v0.4 was checked against it, so treat it as optimistic. Naming a parent or teacher no longer makes a case serious on its own. Hard test set 1 was used to write the rules and is no longer blind. The zero-shot model slot is ready but not enabled (needs model download and GPU).

features.name: How do you feel? question
features.note: Asked after every report on chat and USSD. The answer can only raise severity.

features.name: Language detection and the language question
features.note: Lexicon-based; uses Sunbird language ID when a token is set.

features.name: Translation
features.note: Sunbird client written but not yet tested against the live API (needs a token).

features.name: Telegram bot
features.note: Tested against a fake Telegram API. Goes live with TELEGRAM_TOKEN.

features.name: SMS
features.note: Simulator page and SMS outbox. Africa's Talking sandbox hook ready; a live shortcode needs operator and UCC approval.

features.name: USSD
features.note: Simulator page. Africa's Talking sandbox hook ready.

features.name: WhatsApp bot
features.note: Adapter built and tested against sample Meta payloads; replies go to an outbox until a Meta test number is set up.

features.name: Web chat
features.note: No cookies, nothing stored on the device, quick exit.

features.name: Browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox)
features.note: Server side and platform detection tested; load unpacked to try it.

features.name: Voice notes with transcription
features.note: Record, show, confirm and send all work; turning speech into words needs a Sunbird token or a Whisper model.

features.name: Call with live transcript
features.note: A synthetic call plays out for the officer. Live calls need a voice provider, partner agreement and caller consent.

features.name: Hey Siri, Habari
features.note: Endpoint ready and setup guide in docs/siri-shortcut.md; needs an iPhone to build and test the Shortcut.

features.name: Share to Habari (installable app)
features.note: Android share target and shortcuts. iPhone web apps cannot receive shares.

features.name: U-Report style polls
features.note: JOIN, send and district results work; delivery is through the SMS simulator (Telegram needs a token).

features.name: Location to district and heat map
features.note: District only, coordinates never stored; small districts hidden. Demo uses approximate district centres.

features.name: Referral router and the adult-in-charge rule
features.note: The rule must still be agreed with a child-protection specialist.

features.name: Partner services (Sauti 116, Police CFPU, UCC)
features.note: Mock partners with acknowledgement delays. Real partners and SLAs must be agreed.

features.name: SLA clocks and automatic escalation
features.note: SLA times are proposed targets.

features.name: Officer allocation
features.note: Explainable ranking; supervisors can override.

features.name: Follow-up loop and safety check-in
features.note: Status messages, check-in after resolution, rating, reopen.

features.name: Officer dashboard and partner board
features.note: Reviewed replies only; close needs a reason.

features.name: Urgent case alerts to on-call officers
features.note: Severity 3-4 or high-risk cases show in the Alerts box on the officer dashboard for the on-call and assigned officers. Email and SMS copies are Simulated: email prints to the console and SMS needs officer phone numbers. If no officer is on call, every officer is alerted.

features.name: Case summaries and key details
features.note: Extractive summary from the child's own words.

features.name: Duplicate and repeat-offender finder
features.note: Hashed handles, numbers and links plus similar wording. Multilingual embeddings Planned.

features.name: Knowledge base
features.note: Articles are drafts awaiting review by a child-protection specialist.

features.name: Evaluation and metrics page
features.note: Synthetic and hard test sets; results and limits at /metrics.

features.name: Keycloak roles
features.note: Django groups with the same roles are used for now.

features.name: School mode, parent view, mood trend
features.note: Deferred from the original guideline.

features.name: PostgreSQL
features.note: Used when DB_NAME is set, as in the README setup. Tests and CI run on SQLite.

features.name: Task queue, Docker
features.note: Simple loops for the prototype.
